Settings.NumberOfRays_comment: 1 to 4. Defect_Model.py processes the waveform once per ray (receive branch). Ray k uses SNRk_dB; all other settings are shared. Multipath and thermal noise are independent per ray; phase noise is shared (same oscillator).
Settings.SNR_Reference_comment: Transmit (default): noise is set from the transmitted power, so SNRk_dB is the average SNR and faded rays get a lower SNR. Received: noise is set from each ray's own received power, so every ray gets exactly SNRk_dB.
Settings.RandomSeed_comment: null = new random channels and noise every run. An integer makes runs repeatable (Defect_Model.py --seed overrides it).
Settings.FrequencyOffset_comment: Carrier frequency offset in Hz; positive shifts the spectrum up, negative shifts it down.
Settings.PhaseNoise_comment: PSD mask: SSB phase noise L(f) in dBc/Hz at each offset; interpolated in dB vs log-frequency, end levels held beyond the list. Default approximates the IEEE 802.11n/ac model (-100 dBc/Hz plateau, pole at 250 kHz). Shifting ALL levels by +6 dB doubles the RMS phase error. Typical integrated RMS error: good 0.3-0.5 deg (in-band about -100 to -105 dBc/Hz), average about 1 deg (+6 dB), poor 2-3 deg (+12 to +15 dB).
Settings.PhaseImbalance_comment: Radians (0.0016 rad = 0.09 deg). Typical: low/calibrated 0.0017-0.0087 rad (0.1-0.5 deg); moderate 0.0175 rad (1 deg); high/uncalibrated 0.052-0.087 rad (3-5 deg).
Settings.AmplitudeImbalance_dB_comment: I gain relative to Q: I_Gain = 10^(dB/20), Q_Gain = 1. Typical magnitude: low/calibrated 0.02-0.1 dB; moderate 0.3 dB; high/uncalibrated 0.5-1 dB. Sign does not affect image rejection.
Settings.IQ_Imbalance_comment: Resulting image rejection: low ~43-50 dB, moderate ~34 dB, high ~23-28 dB. Current defaults give 44.7 dB.
Settings.DCOffset_comment: Receiver DC offset power in dB relative to the transmitted signal power (like the SNR: with SNR -12 dB, -22 dBc is 10 dB below the noise). Random phase per ray. Added after thermal noise.
Settings.CW_comment: Continuous-wave interferer: CW_Frequency in Hz relative to the centre frequency (may be negative; the packet detector band is about +-2.75 MHz), CW_Level_dBc in dB relative to the transmitted signal power. Random phase per ray. Added after the frequency offset, before phase noise and thermal noise.
Settings.Sample_Offset_comment: Whole samples only (integer). Positive = signal arrives EARLIER (leading samples dropped, output shorter). Negative = signal DELAYED (spline-extrapolated samples added at the start, output longer).
Settings.Drift_ppm_comment: Sample-clock drift in ppm, whole numbers only (integer). The resampling points themselves fall between samples (spline interpolated). Positive = sampling points slip forward, output shorter. Negative = sampling points slip backward, output longer.
Settings.KFactor_Doppler_comment: Used by Delay_Doppler_Channel (EPA/EVA/ETU). KFactor is linear (not dB), applies to the first path only; 0 = pure Rayleigh, which is how 3GPP defines EPA/EVA/ETU. DopplerFreq is the maximum Doppler shift in Hz; 3GPP pairings are EPA 5 Hz, EVA 5 or 70 Hz, ETU 70 or 300 Hz.
Settings.MultipathModel_comment: Valid values: FIR, EPA, EVA, ETU. FIR uses NumberOfTaps/DelaySpread; EPA/EVA/ETU use MultipathProfiles, KFactor and DopplerFreq.

MultipathProfiles.Profiles_comment: 3GPP TS 36.104 Annex B. Delays in seconds, Power in dB.
